card.name: Salt names inside drug names
card.fires_on: The first piece of the salt or ester part of a drug name, right after the base drug name (e.g. tenofovir DIS-oproxil, formoterol F-umarate, vincristine S-ulfate). Also fires on a space before a section number in parentheses.

modes.label: Salt start after drug
modes.description: Opening piece of the salt word after a drug name such as tenofovir, formoterol, vincristine or fludarabine.
modes.example: methadone, oral contraceptives, raltegravir, rilpivirine, tacrolimus, or tenofovir<< dis>>oproxil fumarate.
